proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Action by Written Consent
proposals.proponent: Kenneth Steiner (proposal submitted via John Chevedden)
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to authorize action to act by written consent, including initiating any appropriate topic.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Relating to Gender/Racial Pay Equity
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Katherine Overton Mountcastle
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender/racial pay gap and associated policy, reputational, competitive, operational and talent risks.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
